name: opabinia
author: Platybelodon_Gabe
description:
you r an outlaw space cowboy pirate trapped in a space prison made of 30ish celestial bodies, the lore is not fully fledged out.

a s d w are the suggested keys to move, you can jump infinitely for now cause jet pack, there might be a fuel system soon. use the arrows to navigate. use q and e to sword and aim with the mouse, there are secret swords. beat as many enemies as possible is the goal right now the game has about 10. there is not good art yet. the combat kind of isn't good yet and the movement is also not good yet, plz leave feedback and share if you want.  

fun space fact: there are no known black dwarfs in the visible universe because the universe is still young :3

bugs and things that need to be fixed:

enemies can't get through atmosphere, might make the gravity come from other game object

movement sucks on the ground and in space

player moves planets

player can't land on fast moving planets

figure out platforming

enemies are too slow :(

some older scripts are a little spaghetti
